error.no_credentials: No client certificate is set up. Add one in Settings → Apps → SmartThings Local.
error.credentials_required: Both the certificate and the private key are required.
error.credentials_not_persisted: Homey did not save the certificate. Try again, and restart the app if it keeps happening.
error.not_recognised: This appliance is no longer recognised as a supported type.
error.wrong_device: {host} is a different appliance now: expected serial {expected}, found {found}.
error.not_writable: {capability} cannot be changed on this appliance.
error.write_rejected: The appliance refused to set {capability} to {value}.
error.repair_no_device: Could not tell which device is being repaired.
error.already_paired: This appliance is already added to Homey ({model} at {host}). Open it from your device list instead.
error.handshake_refused: The appliance is refusing new connections. This usually clears itself within a few minutes; the app keeps retrying.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the appliance at {host}. The app keeps retrying, and searches the network for it by serial number.
error.ac_setpoint_unavailable: This appliance does not accept a target temperature in AI Comfort mode — it reports no setpoint at all while that mode is on, and manages the temperature itself. Set the mode to Cool, Auto, Dry or Heat if you want to choose the temperature.
